== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ローグ3</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ウェッジが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">密閉型。ウェッジ・アンティリーズ中佐が操縦する。ウォーカーの脚を絡めることに成功。反乱軍がエコー基地を脱出する際に乗り捨てられた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rogue 3.

'''Lore''' — Enclosed. Commander Wedge Antilles pilots it. It succeeded in tangling a walker's legs. Abandoned when the Rebels evacuated Echo Base.

'''Game text''' — May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Wedge is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says it succeeded in tangling a walker's legs rather than “Successful walker tripper”, and uses 中佐. Game text uses 位置 rather than Hoth sites.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-rogue3.gif|Original English face]], [[Rogue 3]].</ref>
